blocks.html: Field connections shall meet the requirements for corresponding types of shop connections described in AISC 360. No holes, copes or cuts of any type, or alterations to anchor rods, shall be made to facilitate erection unless specifically shown on the shop or erection drawings or authorized in writing by the registered design professional of record for the structural design.
